notes.title: Mexican Entertainment System is back!
notes.content:
Hello dear players!

It’s been a while since my last update! I want to sincerely thank everyone who has played Space Valkyries, and I’m taking this opportunity to share some exciting news during this Mexican patriotic season.

The Steam event Mexican Entertainment System is back, and both of my games, Tits and Shadows and Space Valkyries, will have a special discount for those who wish to support me.

Additionally, I’m pleased to inform you that Space Valkyries now includes a more recent version of Tezcatlipoca, featuring three different endings: A, B, and C! While there are still two locked rooms, I believe this game shows a lot of potential, and I would love for you to explore it and give it a try.

Thank you for your continued support of my projects.

Sincerely,
Luis Eduardo Sánchez Mora

notes.title: Hotfixes y Tezcatlipoca V1.02
notes.content:
Hotfixes and Tezcatlipoca V1.02

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118293/bc1ddb60f2d52a2089b0bd10a6b9dd9bf113c8ce.png[/img]

First of all, I want to inform you that I have included a demo of my new project, Tezcatlipoca, in Space Valkyries. It's still in its alpha stage, but I believe it has a lot of potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118293/25edefa6b2b036385a7875e0966af5a3b83817b4.png[/img]

The following issues have been fixed:
[list]
[*] Now it's possible to activate and deactivate the special shot by pressing the Ctrl key. 
[*] The sound of the HUD buttons has been reduced, and the tone has been changed to a deeper one to avoid discomfort. 
[*] A hard lock issue when trying to access the database menu and returning without pressing the button has been fixed. 
[/list]

(Note: The biometrics feature will not request any player information; that button is there for aesthetic purposes only.)

notes.title: We're listening to you.
notes.content:
Keyboard support has been added, along with HUD notifications to indicate where projectiles are coming from before they appear.
The keyboard controls aren't perfect, so if you have any suggestions on which buttons to use, that would be fantastic.
We're also working on Ultimate/Perks abilities that can clear the screen of enemies or create barriers to protect the player.

notes.title: Quick bug fix:
notes.content: I have corrected some of the syntax and translation errors. Additionally, I have fixed an error that was corrupting the saved data for the game's audio options..

notes.title: First impressions are bad.
notes.content:
First impressions are bad.

Despite my beliefs, Space Valkyries is in a negative state. I appreciate your feedback and would like to know how to bring the game to an acceptable state. For this reason, I would like to ask those who are taking the time to play for suggestions on how they believe the game could be improved in some way.

Additionally, I have noticed that many people are commenting on writing issues in English. If possible, I would like you to point out these writing or grammar errors so that I can fix them as soon as possible.

I am aware that Space Valkyries is a very small game, and I do not intend for it to be anything more than a video game to pass the time for a few minutes and then forget about it. I truly appreciate those who have dedicated time to this little project of mine.
